_about: The flight definition (world/flight.rs): one stair, ladder or drop between two floors, in one vertical frame (floor y = level * storey). Lengths are cells (1 cell = 1 m of run), heights are metres. storey and rise_total must equal the game's STOREY (world/vertical.rs, 5.0) or the file is refused; slab is the floor/ceiling slab thickness between two storeys. max_riser is the tallest step the walked surface may have: the rise per tread, with steps_per_cell treads per metre of run; a shape that would exceed it is refused. margin_cells is the clear cells kept beyond the landing (upper level) and the foot (lower level). switchback: a well length x (2 * lane_width) cells with a mid landing mid_landing_rise above the lower floor, mid_landing_len cells deep at the far end of the well. straight: a longer flight, length cells long and width cells wide. spiral: a flight around a centre column, radius (cells, a whole number) to the middle of the walkway, lane_width (odd) cells wide, turns of a full circle (0.25, 0.5 or 0.75). shape_weights pick the shape of a stairwell (shape_for); region_weights replace them for the listed levels (key = level number).
